painPoints.impact: Users pay $99 for a text editor
Users get annoyed by nag screen

painPoints.problem: Limited built-in features compared to IDEs
painPoints.impact: Users need to install many plugins
Users who want 100% free can't use it

painPoints.problem: Plugin ecosystem is smaller than VS Code's

whySwitch: Get a free, open-source text editor with VS Code
Get better plugin ecosystem with VS Code
Use a free, open-source text editor with Atom (discontinued but still usable)

alternatives.name: VS Code
alternatives.reason: 100% free and open-source text editor with massive plugin ecosystem
alternatives.description: VS Code is a free and open-source text editor. It has a massive plugin ecosystem. 100% free — no premium tier. Cross-platform (Mac, Windows, Linux).
alternatives.bestFor: Developers who want a free, open-source text editor with massive plugin ecosystem

alternatives.name: Vim
alternatives.reason: 100% free and open-source, modal text editor
alternatives.description: Vim is a free and open-source modal text editor. It's very lightweight and powerful. 100% free — no premium tier. Cross-platform (Mac, Windows, Linux).
alternatives.bestFor: Developers who want a free, open-source, lightweight text editor with modal editing

alternatives.name: Notepad++
alternatives.reason: 100% free and open-source text editor for Windows
alternatives.description: Notepad++ is a free and open-source text editor for Windows. It's very lightweight. 100% free — no premium tier. Windows only.
cons: Less powerful than VS Code for development
alternatives.bestFor: Windows users who want a free, lightweight text editor

steps: Export your Sublime Text settings (if needed)
Import settings into VS Code (or start fresh)
Install plugins in VS Code to match your Sublime Text setup
Buy Sublime Text license only if you prefer it over VS Code
tips: VS Code is the best free alternative for most users
Vim is best if you want modal editing and lightweight
Notepad++ is best for Windows users who want lightweight editor

faqs.question: Is there a completely free alternative to Sublime Text?
faqs.answer: Yes. VS Code is 100% free and open-source. Vim and Notepad++ are also free and open-source.

faqs.question: Which Sublime Text alternative has the best plugin ecosystem?
faqs.answer: VS Code has the best plugin ecosystem — much larger than Sublime Text's.

faqs.question: Can I migrate my Sublime Text plugins to VS Code?
faqs.answer: You can't directly migrate plugins, but VS Code has equivalent plugins for most Sublime Text plugins.

steps: Export your IntelliJ Ultimate project settings
Import project into IntelliJ Community Edition

faqs.question: Is there a completely free alternative to IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate?
faqs.answer: Yes. IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition is free. Eclipse and VS Code + Java Extension Pack are also free and open-source.

faqs.question: Which IntelliJ IDEA alternative is best for Java development?
faqs.answer: IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition is the best free alternative for Java development.

faqs.question: Can I migrate my IntelliJ Ultimate project to Community Edition?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can export your project settings and import into Community Edition. Most projects work without changes.
